name: Benchmark v2 Set

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      task_count:
        description: 'Number of top reward tasks to benchmark (1‑10)'
        required: true
        default: '2'
        type: number
      agent:
        description: 'Runner image to use'
        required: true
        default: 'ubuntu-latest'
        type: string
      provider:
        description: 'Provider to use'
        required: true
        default: 'openai'
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model to use'
        required: true
        default: 'gpt-4o'
        type: string
      timeout:
        description: 'Timeout for each benchmark run'
        required: true
        default: '30m'
        type: string

jobs:
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      selected: ${{ steps.select.outputs.selected }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Generate selected task list
        id: select
        run: |
          TASKS=$(cat data/v2-top-reward-tasks.json)
          SELECTED=$(echo "$TASKS" | jq -c ".[:${{ inputs.task_count }}]")
          echo "selected=$SELECTED" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  benchmark:
    needs: generate
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.agent }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        task: ['6883', '14127', '15289_1', '14958', '17387_1', '14294', '12155_1', '14857', '14340', '14223_1']
      max-parallel: 1
    env:
      PROVIDER: ${{ inputs.provider }}
      MODEL: ${{ inputs.model }}
      TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.timeout }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Task
        uses: arduino/setup-task@v2
        with:
          version: ${{ matrix.task }}
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run Benchmark
        if: ${{ contains(needs.generate.outputs.selected, matrix.task) }}
        run: |
          bun scripts/run-benchmark-v2.ts ${{ matrix.task }}

      - name: Upload Benchmark Artifact
        if: ${{ contains(needs.generate.outputs.selected, matrix.task) }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-${{ matrix.task }}
          path: ./benchmark-output/${{ matrix.task }}.json

      - name: Publish Benchmark
        if: ${{ contains(needs.generate.outputs.selected, matrix.task) }}
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: "Benchmark v2 – Task ${{ matrix.task }}"
          tool: "benchmark"
          output-file-path: "./benchmark-output/${{ matrix.task }}.json"
          gh-pages-branch: "gh-pages"
          gh-repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          benchmark-data-dir-path: "./benchmark-data"
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          auto-push: true
          skip-fetch-gh-pages: false
          comment-always: true
          summary-always: true
          save-data-file: true
          comment-on-alert: true
          alert-threshold: 0.1
